_classes.name: sunset extension stored with a non-actor actor_raw ('the provisions of ...') and agency Unspecified
_classes.rule: re.match(r'(the )?provisions? of\b', actor_raw.lower()) OR (agency=='Unspecified' and extends_existing and re.search(r'remain in full force|deemed repealed|shall expire', quote))

_classes.name: sunset extension of an earlier chapter, title names no government holder: no record and no dropped entry (vs a stored Unspecified record in 2009-S6753)
_classes.rule: needs judgment: Oct 19 rule routes these to re-ask (sunset_extension_unnamed_holder); after tonight's re-ask the outcome differs by law

_classes.name: 'any agency of the state' left Unspecified instead of State agencies / State of New York
_classes.rule: re.search(r'agenc(y|ies) of the state|state agenc', actor_raw.lower()) and agency=='Unspecified'

_classes.name: fixed_date deadline with no deadline_text (date borrowed from a neighbouring sentence)
new list item added to an existing list stored extends_existing false
_classes.rule: kind_list_item is True and rescued_imperative_item is True and extends_existing is False (upper bound: also matches items in wholly new sections, needs a per-law check that the section is 'amended')

_classes.name: same-as-chapter date taken from the referenced chapter's AMENDED clause when this law rewrites that clause after the original date had passed (criterion 8: original date stands)
_classes.rule: effective_dates[law].rule=='same_as_chapter' and reference.rule!='immediately' and the packet LAW TEXT matches r'This act shall take effect \[[^\]]*\]'; count records with that matter_id

_classes.name: passive duty with no named actor in new matter not extracted ('shall be accepted for recording', 'Schools shall safeguard')
_classes.rule: needs judgment (misses are not in the stored data)
